prompt: Address PCI configuration space with the layout `enable(31) | bus(23..16) | device(15..11) | function(10..8) | register(7..2)`.

trace.label: [value written to 0xCF8] to read offset `0x0E` of bus 0, device 3, function 1
[shift] applied to the dword to extract the 16-bit field at offset `0x0E`
[class code] from the dword at offset `0x08` equal to `0x03000002` (class is the top byte)
[BAR size] of a memory BAR whose all-ones write reads back `0xFFFF0008` (`~(mask & ~0xF) + 1`)

explain: The address is 0x80000000 | (3 << 11) | (1 << 8) | (0x0E & 0xFC) = 0x8000190C: the enable bit, device 3 in bits 11 to 15, function 1 in bits 8 to 10, and the register with its low two bits cleared, because reads are whole aligned dwords. The 16-bit field at offset 2 within that dword is shifted by (0x0E & 2) * 8 = 16. In the dword at 0x08 the layout is revision (byte 0), prog-if, subclass, class (byte 3), so 0x03 is a display controller. For the BAR, the bits the device does not implement read as 0: masking off the four flag bits gives 0xFFFF0000, the complement plus one is 0x10000, which is 64 KiB.
